bool  isAuthorized,
const char *  pErrorString,
const char *  pDomainName,
HxCertificateSecurityWarningResult *  pResult 
)

Show the certificate security warning dialog.

This function launches a dialog which provides interface to accept, view, or cancel a dialog which was not able to be confirmed with its server.

Parameters:
pCertPath IN: Path to the installed certificate
isAuthorized IN: TRUE if authorized, false if client certificate
pErrorString IN: Error string describing the failure
pDomainName IN: Domain name for the certificate
pResult OUT: Returns which button the user selected.
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

Show a dialog that views the certificate info.

This function launches a dialog which shows certificate info. The certificate info includes all text from the certificate.

Parameters:
pCertPath IN: Path to the installed certificate
isAuthorized IN: TRUE if authorized, false if client certificate
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.
